definitions.launch_index: Zero-based position within the fixed forward, excluding setup_anchor.
definitions.metrics: Raw Nsight Compute values and units. The collected execution is instrumented.
definitions.cycles: SM avg/max elapsed cycles are not summed across SMs; not whole-forward cycles.
definitions.ncu_kernel_time_sum_ns: Sum of profiled kernel durations, not normal whole-layer event time.
definitions.dram_bytes: Hardware-observed traffic at DRAM; explicit CUDA copies outside profiled kernels excluded.
definitions.l2_bytes: L2 read/write sectors times 32 bytes; not logical tensor bytes or multicast destination bytes.
definitions.sass_warp_instructions: Warp-level native instruction count, not PTX instruction count.
definitions.application_event_inflation_ratio: Profiled application CUDA event / same-job bare event. Includes tool preparation; not a kernel slowdown factor.
definitions.native_first_forward_cuda_event_ms: One bare forward immediately before profiling in a separate process on the same GPU. No software warmup; no empty-cache guarantee.
definitions.percentage_metrics: Kept per launch; percentages are not added across launches.
definitions.replication: One counter sample per launch; application replay may combine multiple executions.
definitions.profiled_application_cuda_event_ms: Application CUDA event from the final replay process; its output JSON overwrites earlier passes. Includes profiler overhead.
